controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T08:52:52.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-19T09:52:52.000Z"
  AND host.name == "db-1"
  AND process.name == "sshd"
  AND event.outcome == "success"
| STATS total = COUNT(*),
        distinct_ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(source.ip),
        distinct_users = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.name),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                              message LIKE "*password*",  "password", "other")
